questions.explanation_english: The Abhidhamma Pitaka contains code of discipline and rules for Buddhist monks (Bhikkhus). The Pali Canon (Tipitaka) forms the core scriptural text of Theravada Buddhism. The Vinaya Pitaka contains monastic rules and conduct codes governing Buddhist monks (Bhikkhus) and nuns. In contrast, the Abhidhamma Pitaka comprises advanced philosophical, metaphysical, and psychological analyses of Buddhist doctrines. The Sutta Pitaka contains doctrinal discourses divided into five Nikayas, including moral verses compiled within popular texts like the Dhammapada.
